title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: customer-first direct callback with callback profiles
summary: The callback behaviour, irreversible enablement and credit-consumption warning are supported. The onboarding path omits the prerequisite AI-agent enablement choice, and the queue control links to a page that does not document selecting a callback profile. The roles paragraph should also acknowledge Microsoft's differing Contact Center prerequisite.

claims.claim: Classic direct callback assigns the request to a representative before calling the customer.
claims.quote: In the classic direct callback experience, the system assigns a callback request to a representative before it calls the customer.

claims.claim: In the classic experience the representative waits while the call attempt completes.
claims.quote: If the customer doesn't answer, the call reaches voicemail, or the number is unavailable, the representative waits while the call attempt completes.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: Customer-first callback initiates the customer call when the request reaches the front of the queue and a representative is available.
claims.quote: When the callback request reaches the front of the queue and at least one representative is available, the system initiates the callback.

claims.claim: The system connects a representative after the customer answers and completes any required verification.
claims.quote: After the customer answers and completes any required verification, the system connects the customer to an available representative.

claims.claim: Administrators configure the experience through callback profiles in Copilot Service admin center.
claims.quote: Callback profiles control how callbacks are handled for customers. Create multiple profiles and apply them to different queues or overflow scenarios to meet specific business requirements.

claims.quote: Callback offering window: Turn on the toggle to define when the system can offer callback requests.

claims.claim: A profile configures duplicate prevention.
claims.quote: Duplicate prevention: Choose the setting for the system to check for duplicates to prevent customers from creating multiple callback requests
